model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates public opinion on the most important measures that businesses believe should be taken to limit the “hidden economy” in the country, with responses categorized by specific policy actions and their corresponding percentage support. The vertical axis lists 13 distinct policy measures in Bulgarian, ranging from “Да се засили граничния контрол” (Strengthen border control) at the top to “Да се намали личния подоходен данък” (Reduce personal income tax) at the bottom, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents, scaled from 0% to approximately 15%, with tick marks at 5% intervals. Bars are color-coded: blue for lower-support measures and red for higher-support ones, though no legend explicitly defines this. The highest-rated measure is “Да се намали корупцията” (Reduce corruption), at 13%, followed closely by “Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса” (Introduce more effective business incentives) at 12% (inferred from bar length), and “Да се подобри качеството на административните...” (Improve the quality of administrative...) at 13%. Other notable measures include “Да се ограничат действията на мафията” (Limit mafia activities) at 10%, and “Да се засили данъчния контрол” (Strengthen tax control) at 9%. Lower-rated measures include “Да се засили граничния контрол” and “Да се намалят акцизите” (Reduce excise taxes), both at 2%. The chart is not sorted by value, and no bars are emphasized with shading or outlines beyond their color coding.
